description: Mutation language in the FIRST SENTENCE of a tool description. Signal 3 of 3 for write capability, and the weakest — consulted only when annotations and the name are both silent. Restricted to the first sentence because later sentences routinely describe what a read tool's results can be used for ('...which you can then update').
sourceNotes: Phrases, not bare verbs, because description prose is looser than a tool name. A bare 'create' in a description often refers to what the caller may do next rather than what the tool does.
